text:
Lina: Heads-up: we're about to tighten KMS decrypt scope for service accounts (infra-keystore-*). Will affect cert-rotator and any interregion mTLS handshakes that call KMS. Need quick audit: what services talk to KMS during cert issuance/validation across eu-west/us-east? Also adding requirement: all TLS endpoints >=1.3 and ciphersuite whitelist.

Omar: which policy change? can you paste diff? :thinking:

Lina: Patch:
```
- Effect: Allow kms:Decrypt to Principal: *
+ Effect: Allow kms:Decrypt to Principal: arn:aws:iam::123456789:role/redwood-keystore-rotator
```
We'll remove the broad role. rotator will be a tied role per region.

Priya: Important: rotator runs in each region and uses cross-account key aliases for copies. If you restrict without adding regional rotator roles, we'll see failed unwraps and mTLS cert refresh errors. Need to ensure key grants replicate or we update rotator to use regional aliases.

cert-rotator-bot: [INFO] 2026-03-20T15:12Z keystore-eu: unwrap failed kms:Decrypt AccessDenied for role arn:aws:iam::123456789:role/old-rotator

Eli: For the rollout plan: 1) run audit to list services with KMS decrypt calls (cloudtrail query), 2) create per-region rotator roles, 3) add iam condition for sourceVPC if possible, 4) smoke test cert refresh in staging eu-west then promote. I can run the cloudtrail query.

Marta: On mTLS/TLS hardening: ensure clients include full cert chain in SNI/proxy config. Also add a fallback that accepts decrypt via a short-lived local key during rollout so we don't break east-west traffic.

Lina: Thanks. @Eli can you paste the cloudtrail query here? Also @Priya can you open a small PR to make rotator fail noisier and surface KMS errors in logs (we're missing the region key id in logs).

Eli: CloudTrail query (quick):
```
lookup-events | filter EventName = "Decrypt*" or EventName = "GenerateDataKey*" | filter EventTime >= "2026-03-01"
```
I'll run and post results in 30m.

Priya: I'll raise PR: add region + key_alias to logs and a non-fatal fallback flag `LOCAL_KEY_IF_DECRYPT_FAIL=true` gated by env in staging.

Lina: One more ask: audit logging — we need to push KMS decrypt events to security-audit for 365 days retention. @Marta can you coordinate with compliance for retention policy?

Marta: Yep, will file ticket and ping compliance. Also propose adding an alert: >3 decrypt failures per minute for any rotator -> slack #security-oncall.

Eli: On-call for rollout is me and Priya for 24h after change. I'll put a short runbook in the doc.

Lina: Great. I'll schedule the change and post a short abort checklist before applying. TY everyone :rocket:
